text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That "Tower of Babel" is...
free to read in full for 24 hours only...!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I've been wanting
to read this manga!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It's getting late, but...
I'll just read one volume♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And once Kiseki began reading the opening,
she was completely drawn in
and ended up staying up late.
